reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Rejected on review: breaks Escape for every default dialog
summary: The Escape keydown handler now runs for modal dialogs too and calls preventDefault() before it checks the keyboard option, so the keyboard: false dialog stays open, as the task requires.
caveats: An ordinary dialog with the default keyboard: true no longer closes on Escape either, checked in Chromium without inference. The frozen task had no such dialog.

The stricter case bootstrap6-dialog-escape-keyboard-false-default-dialog adds one with a guard. This patch fails it, while the four earlier model patches for this bug and the pending human fix (#43077) pass it.
It also removes the static-backdrop bounce that signals a dialog cannot be dismissed.
